items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: although I had heard about the Dorsey Brothers... whom I hadn't met yet.

ctx.x: A fellow by the name of Hack Gibson, Francis Gibson. I think his father put a little money in the band or helped him out someway, but anyway Fred would come down and he would come down with a banjo with one of those soft picks and he -- everybody played a banjo in those days, you know, it was all ukelele fingering.

So the Mason Dixon -- then I heard the Scranton Sirens and although I had heard about the Dorsey Brothers, because they were from I think Laneeford, not far away in the coal regions, but I had made up my mind, I had an offer from the Scranton Sirens.
